content: तर्कः (तर्क्-भावे अच्) .²1 Supposition, conjecture, guess; प्रसन्नस्ते तर्कः <ls>V. 2</ls>. .²2 Reasoning, speculation, discussion, abstract reasoning; कुतः पुनरस्मिन्नवधारिते आगमार्थे तर्कनिमित्तस्याक्षेपस्यावकाशः; इदानीं तर्कनिमित्त आक्षेपः परिह्रियते <ls>Ś. B.</ls>; तर्कोऽप्रतिष्ठः स्मृतयो विभिन्नाः <ls>Mb.</ls>; <ls>Ms. 12. 106</ls>. .²3 Doubt. .²4 Logic, the science of logic; यत्काव्यं मधुवर्षि धर्षितपरास्तर्केषु यस्योक्तयः <ls>N. 22. 155</ls>; तर्कशास्त्रम्, तर्कदीपिका .²5 (In logic) Reduction to absurdity, a conclusion opposed to the premises, a {%reductio ad absurdum%}. .²6 A system of doctrine founded on pure reasoning or free thinking, a philosophical system (particularly one of the six principal Darṣanas <ab>q. v.</ab>). .²7 A name for the number ‘six’. .²8 Supplying an ellipsis. .²9 Cause, motive. .²10 Wish, desire. .{@-र्का@} Speculation, reasoning.
